tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.title: Search knowledge
tools.description: Ranked, cited passages for an open question. Each result has chunk_id, citation (path and lines), content, root_id and section_path. An empty list is not proof of absence: check truncated and pending_files.

inputSchema.title: search_knowledge request
inputSchema.description: The params object of the `search_knowledge` tool. Ranked, cited chunks for an open question. Principal labels are never a caller field: the host supplies the scope (docs/tool-schemas.md).

query.description: The question or words to search for.

candidate_k.description: How many candidates each channel gathers before fusion.

path_prefix.description: Only record paths starting with this prefix (`root_id/path` form).

retrieval_mode.description: lexical uses words only; vector and hybrid need an index with vectors, else vectors are ignored.

roots.description: Root ids to search. Narrows the server's roots, never widens them; absent or null means every root the server allows.

search_field.description: Opt-in filename navigation or combined lexical retrieval; requires explicit lexical retrieval_mode. both (since 2.3.0) ranks each file once by its best passage's score plus its folder and file names' title part, a score-level merge that candidate_k does not cut.

outputSchema.title: search_knowledge result
outputSchema.description: The shared evidence envelope: ranked chunks with citations. Since S3-T6 each item names its root_id and section_path, and the result carries truncated and pending_files over the same scope (the v1 fields are unchanged). No `empty` flag: an empty results list is not proof of absence.

vector_mode.description: Vector mode, when the index has vectors.

search_field.description: Search field. both (since 2.3.0) is a score-level merge, one result per file: the file's best body chunk's BM25 plus its title part; candidate_k is validated but does not cut it.

title_policy_id.description: Title policy id (contract 2.3.0): present whenever the lexical channel ran under content or both. A file's folder names and file stem (title-field-v1, docs/title-field-v1.md) add a BM25 part to its best chunk.

fuzzy_policy_id.description: Fuzzy policy id (contract 2.4.0): present whenever the lexical channel ran under content or both. A query word of 5 or more Latin code points that no chunk in scope and no visible file's name holds is also searched as up to 3 dictionary words within 1 edit (5 code points) or 2 edits (6 or more) sharing its first letter (fuzzy-v1, docs/fuzzy-v1.md).

fold_policy_id.description: Fold policy id (contract 2.5.0; fold-groups-v2 since 2.6.0): present whenever the lexical channel ran under content or both. A query word is also searched as the words of the files in scope and the visible file names that share its fold key: case and compatibility forms folded, Latin accents dropped, an English plural or one of seven Tamil suffixes taken off (fold-groups-v1, docs/fold-groups-v1.md). Contract 2.6.0 (fold-groups-v2, docs/fold-groups-v2.md) adds its -ing and -ed verb forms (paint, painted, painting; hop, hopped, hoping; tidy, tidied): a word no chunk in scope and no visible file name holds is searched as the forms they hold; a word they hold is also searched as its forms no more common than itself, at half weight. Misspelling tolerance (fuzzy-v1) runs only on the words that have no such group.

results.description: Ranked chunks, best first. Empty is not proof of absence.

chunk_id.description: Stable chunk id; pass it to read_chunk.

path.description: Record path: `root_id/path` for a host root.

score.description: Score: the body BM25 plus, since 2.3.0, the title part (ranking.title.score).

filename.description: Filename-field lexical score and rank, when that field is requested.

title.description: The weighted title part inside this result's score (contract 2.3.0). Under content only the one chunk per file that received its file's part carries it; under both every result carries it, null when the file's title took no part.

score.description: Title part, null when none was added.

root_id.description: Root id of the chunk's file (S3-T6); the citation path is `root_id/path` for a host root.

section_path.description: Heading path of the chunk's section, [] for a file without headings (S3-T6).

match_sections.description: Two source-specific views in filename/both results. matched and matched_terms describe analyzed terms actually in each displayed source, independently of which candidate channel contributed to ranking.

answer_policy.description: The policy the answer must follow.

filename_matches_are_navigation.description: Filename matches help navigation; the cited body is evidence.

warnings.description: Why a result list is empty or poor (when present).

term.description: The analysed query term, when relevant.

expansions.description: Contract 2.4.0, query_term_expanded only: the dictionary words also searched for term, best first.

members.description: Contract 2.5.0, query_term_grouped only: the words also searched for term because they share its fold key or, since 2.6.0, are among its -ing and -ed verb forms (fold-groups-v2), in the group's order, term left out.

truncated.description: True when a file in scope was given to the engine but not indexed in full (too large, unreadable or over a run's byte budget): the corpus may be incomplete (S3-T6).

pending_files.description: Files in scope still waiting for their bytes; the corpus may be incomplete when above 0 (S3-T6).

# Boat from harbour

Boat leaves harbour at ten, returns by noon. Grey ones lie on rocks near
lighthouse, pups too, white, fluffy, blinking. Pack binoculars, waterproofs,
flask, spare socks; it is windy out past headland, so wear hats. Pay at
kiosk on quay, cash only, then queue by railings.

## Times tables test

The times tables test is on Friday mornings. Fifty questions in five minutes,
mixed tables, and the score goes in the reading record.

## School time

பள்ளி காலை எட்டரை மணிக்குத் தொடங்கும். நாங்கள் எட்டு மணிக்கு வீட்டிலிருந்து புறப்படுவோம்.

## Next term

Swimming will resume after the October holiday, at the same time.

# Autumn term

Wren's group goes to Brook Street pool on Tuesday afternoons. The coach leaves
at one and comes back at half past two. Lessons last forty minutes in the
small pool, with two teachers in the water and one on the side. Badges for
five metres, ten metres and floating on your back are given out in the last
week. Bring a hat if the hair is long, and a snack for the coach back.

Dear parents and carers,

Year 5 will go on a ﬁeld trip to Hollow Woods on Tuesday 18 November.

With thanks,
Mr Quarrie

## Band

The band concert is in March. Instruments go home over the break.

## Reading at home

Twenty minutes of reading every night, signed by a grown-up.

## Show and tell

Wren may bring one thing from home on Friday for show and tell.

Pip can start flute lessons next year if she keeps up the recorder.

## Next week

Next week we paint the pot we made, and then the teacher puts on a clear glaze
and fires it in the kiln.

## Wren

Ear check in October; all clear. Next check in the spring.

## Next term

Swimming will resume after the October holiday, at the same time.

## Bins

Take the bins out on the right night and bring the bins in the next morning.

the poster both come in that morning, and the poster names three real kinds of
eruption.

## Week 9

- Volcano model due soon: keep working on it at home.
- Our classroom moves upstairs next week; the old room becomes the music room.
